{{Quote|Go back to Mikkia, you fiends!!|A [[Unidentified Pau'an (Bracront)|Pau'an guard]], to numerous Mikkians|<ref name="The High Republic Adventures 1">[[The High Republic Adventures (2023) 1|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2023) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Mikkia''' was a [[planet]] with a variety of climates located in [[the galaxy]]'s [[Expansion Region]], and home to the [[Mikkian]] [[species]]. Mikkia was a member of the [[Galactic Republic]] for thousands of [[Standard year|years]].<ref name="KoF" /> During the [[High Republic Era]], [[Jedi Master]] [[Mirro Lox]] and his [[Padawan]] [[Amadeo Azzazzo]] helped assist and rescue people during a large [[Groundquake on Mikkia|groundquake]] on the planet.<ref name="Call of Coruscant" /> The [[Order 66|destruction]] of the [[Jedi Order]] contributed to a high level of anti-[[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] sentiment on Mikkia.<ref name="KoF" />
